purpose: Phase-8A resistance-burden aggregation. Combines the bounded component burdens (intrinsic / tolerance / adaptive / persistent / microenvironment-protection / immune-escape) into a single BOUNDED total_resistance_burden using a documented saturating aggregation - NEVER a naive unbounded sum, and with explicit correlation discounting to avoid double counting overlapping mechanisms. Schematic normalized only.

coefficient_policy.valid_range: every component burden and total_resistance_burden in [0,1]
coefficient_policy.1_interpretation: 1 = maximal schematic resistance burden the model represents
coefficient_policy.sensitivity_note: aggregation weights + correlation discount tune how components combine; the saturating form guarantees boundedness.
coefficient_policy.limitations: No absolute resistance metric; normalized only (NOT_REPORTED quantitatively).

aggregation.note: total = 1 - PRODUCT over components of (1 - w_i * b_i); a saturating combination bounded in [0,1] that avoids naive summation and softens correlated contributions.

correlation_discount.note: Tolerance and adaptive burdens partially overlap (shared survival phenotype); the smaller of the two is discounted by this factor before aggregation to avoid double counting.

dominant_mechanism_rule: dominant_mechanism = the component with the largest weighted contribution; ties resolve deterministically by the fixed component order.

rules.bounded: total_resistance_burden is always in [0,1]; no unbounded sum.
rules.no_double_count: Correlated components (tolerance/adaptive) are discounted; microenvironment protection already folded into effective exposure is not re-added.
rules.immune_absent: immune_escape_burden is 0 while Phase 7C is UNAVAILABLE (not fabricated).
